method.readback: raw rgba8unorm, lossless PNG; no JPEG or browser resampling
method.reference: independent CPU ideal butt-cap/bevel-join polygon union, 4×4 subpixels (16 samples) per render pixel
method.colorSpace: linear unlit source RGB; no tone mapping, exposure or temporal accumulation
method.width: identical declared CSS widths for analytic and hard-edge baseline; render density explicitly recorded
method.performance: paired elapsed submission-to-completion, warmed; includes CPU submission and GPU completion, excludes readback and shader compilation

paving.metricRationale: MSE against integrated mean includes spatial alias variance and mean bias. A phase-locked hard pattern can have zero variance while missing every joint.

silhouettes.fixture: Opaque roof with and without production late-pass stroke entirely beneath it; equal resolution; full-scene browser acceptance is additional

performance.workload: 49 long crossing polylines; production material; CSS192×128; native WebGPU; not browser FPS

joinLighting.method: Actual production geometry/vertex/coverage shader; green=GPU front_facing, red=back_facing; original alpha retained
